title: 第70章 他是个孤儿
content_zh:
第70章 他是个孤儿-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

存书签
下一章
南宁火车站，379团三营全体指战员已经登车完毕。除了他们之外，还有源源不断赶来的部队正在集结。
闷罐车内，战士们正扒在门口，望着桂省这片土地。站台上站着许多桂省的群众，篮子里装着水果或者鸡蛋，一个劲儿地往车上递，车站拉着横幅“欢送新时代最可爱的人”。
战士们露出羞涩的笑容挥手拒绝，下面的群众一个劲儿地喊着：“孩子们，拿点吧，回去的路上吃！”
“是啊，拿点吧，李子解渴！”
新集结过来的部队看到这一幕，全体敬礼相送。部队政工干部们，趁机向战士们做思想工作，告诉他们什么叫做人民子弟兵，什么叫做军人的荣誉。
“只有勇敢、无畏的军人，才能获得人民的礼遇！那些孬种，会被永远钉在耻辱柱上。全体都有，向127师的同志们学习，向127师的同志们致敬！”
军列上，通讯兵在车厢里跑着传令：“各连队注意，关闭车厢，不准拿群众一针一线！”
在群众期盼、感谢的目光中，战士们快速关上了车厢门。顿时，闷罐车和外面隔成了两个世界。
等列车出了车站，车厢门重新打开，两边摆上木梯防止战士们发生意外。回去的路上不再需要严格保密，在列车上，大家可以适时开门通风。
刚开始战士们坐在车厢里，眼睛盯着外面的山或者河流，很少有人说话。等出了桂省，气氛才逐渐活跃起来。
大家尽情地享受着阳光、空气，以及清晨露水和泥土的芳香。晚上，大家躺在稻草秆上，睡得比在床上还香，腿压着胳膊，脑袋枕着大腿，横七竖八，鼾声如雷。
有的战士一觉醒来，胳膊都被压肿了。
此次转回驻地，重伤员有专列运输，轻伤员随各自单位列车返回，刘济民让卫生员时刻注意轻伤员的情况。
军列一路北上，经过大小车站的时候，总是能够看到得知军列路过消息的群众过来送行。看到战士们还穿着遍布战争痕迹的军装，一个个忍不住泪流满面。
列车抵达洛阳后，各界民众举办了盛大的欢迎仪式。无数的百姓汇聚在道路两旁，手里拿着红旗，举着横幅，高喊着“欢迎”的口号。
在雄壮的军乐中，战士们昂首挺胸，踩着鼓点，迈着雄壮的步伐走进了洛阳城。
当回到豫省，听到熟悉的口音，战士们的心情可想而知。他们和道路两旁的父老乡亲握手击掌，共同庆祝战争的胜利。
孩子们在老师的带领下，系着红领巾，高喊：“向解放军叔叔学习！向解放军叔叔致敬！”
宋大根蹲到一个孩子身旁，用脑袋抵住孩子的脑袋，笑着做游戏。

At Nanning Railway Station, all the commanders and fighters of the third battalion of the 379th Regiment have boarded the train. In addition to them, there was a steady stream of troops coming and gathering.
Inside the tank truck, the soldiers were standing at the door, looking at the land of Guangxi Province. There were many people from Guangxi Province standing on the platform, with baskets filled with fruits or eggs, which they kept handing to the car. The station held a banner that read "Farewell to the cutest person in the new era."
The soldiers showed shy smiles and waved their hands to refuse. The crowd below kept shouting: "Children, take some and eat on the way back!"
"Yeah, take some, plums will quench your thirst!"
When the newly assembled troops saw this scene, they all saluted. The army political cadres took the opportunity to do ideological work with the soldiers, telling them what it means to be a people's soldier and what the honor of a soldier is.
"Only brave and fearless soldiers can receive the courtesy of the people! Those cowards will be nailed to the pillar of shame forever. Everyone, learn from the comrades of the 127th Division and pay tribute to the comrades of the 127th Division!"
On the military train, the communication soldiers were running in the carriages to deliver orders: "Attention, all companies, close the carriages, and no one is allowed to take advantage of the masses!"
Under the expectant and grateful eyes of the masses, the soldiers quickly closed the carriage door. Suddenly, the tank truck and the outside became two different worlds.
When the train left the station, the carriage door was reopened and wooden ladders were placed on both sides to prevent accidents among the soldiers. There is no need to keep things strictly secret on the way back. On the train, everyone can open the door for ventilation at the right time.
At first, the soldiers sat in the carriage, staring at the mountains or rivers outside, and few people spoke. After leaving Guangxi Province, the atmosphere gradually became lively.
Everyone enjoyed the sunshine, air, and the fragrance of morning dew and earth. At night, everyone lay on the straw and slept better than on the bed. Their legs pressed their arms, their heads rested on their thighs, and they snored loudly.
Some soldiers woke up with their arms swollen.
During this transfer back to the station, the severely injured were transported by special trains, while the lightly injured returned with their respective units' trains. Liu Jimin asked the health workers to always pay attention to the situation of the lightly injured.
As the military column went all the way north, when passing through various stations, you could always see people who had heard about the passing military column coming to see it off. Seeing the soldiers still wearing military uniforms with traces of war, they all couldn't help but burst into tears.
After the train arrived in Luoyang, people from all walks of life held a grand welcome ceremony. Countless people gathered on both sides of the road, holding red flags and banners and shouting "Welcome" slogans.
In the majestic military music, the soldiers held their heads high, stepped on the drums, and walked into Luoyang City with majestic steps.
When returning to Yu Province and hearing familiar accents, you can imagine the mood of the soldiers. They shook hands and high-fived the fellow villagers on both sides of the road to celebrate the victory of the war.
Led by the teacher, the children wore red scarves and shouted: "Learn from the uncles of the People's Liberation Army! Salute the uncles of the People's Liberation Army!"
Song Dagen squatted down next to a child, put his head against the child's head, and played games with a smile.
